WITH current_ids AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT anon_2.identity_id AS identity_id 
FROM (SELECT seed_lots.botanical_identity_id AS identity_id, $1::VARCHAR AS category, CASE WHEN (seed_lots.lifecycle = $2::VARCHAR) THEN $3::INTEGER ELSE $4::INTEGER END AS current, CASE WHEN (seed_lots.lifecycle = $5::VARCHAR) THEN $6::INTEGER ELSE $7::INTEGER END AS living 
FROM seed_lots UNION ALL SELECT plants.botanical_identity_id AS identity_id, $8::VARCHAR AS category, CASE WHEN (plants.lifecycle = $9::VARCHAR) THEN $10::INTEGER ELSE $11::INTEGER END AS current, CASE WHEN (plants.lifecycle = $12::VARCHAR) THEN $13::INTEGER ELSE $14::INTEGER END AS living 
FROM plants UNION ALL SELECT plant_groups.botanical_identity_id AS identity_id, $15::VARCHAR AS category, CASE WHEN (plant_groups.lifecycle = $16::VARCHAR) THEN $17::INTEGER ELSE $18::INTEGER END AS current, CASE WHEN (plant_groups.lifecycle = $19::VARCHAR) THEN $20::INTEGER ELSE $21::INTEGER END AS living 
FROM plant_groups UNION ALL SELECT vegetative_lots.botanical_identity_id AS botanical_identity_id, $22::VARCHAR AS anon_3, CASE WHEN (vegetative_lots.lifecycle = $23::VARCHAR) THEN $24::INTEGER ELSE $25::INTEGER END AS anon_4, $26::INTEGER AS anon_5 
FROM vegetative_lots 
WHERE vegetative_lots.lifecycle != $27::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT vegetative_lots.botanical_identity_id AS botanical_identity_id, $28::VARCHAR AS anon_6, CASE WHEN (propagation_attempts.lifecycle = $29::VARCHAR) THEN $30::INTEGER ELSE $31::INTEGER END AS anon_7, $32::INTEGER AS anon_8 
FROM propagation_attempts JOIN vegetative_lots ON vegetative_lots.id = propagation_attempts.vegetative_lot_id 
WHERE propagation_attempts.lifecycle != $33::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT seed_lots.botanical_identity_id AS botanical_identity_id, $34::VARCHAR AS anon_9, CASE WHEN (sowings.lifecycle = $35::VARCHAR) THEN $36::INTEGER ELSE $37::INTEGER END AS anon_10, $38::INTEGER AS anon_11 
FROM sowings JOIN seed_lots ON seed_lots.id = sowings.seed_lot_id UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(plants.botanical_identity_id, plant_groups.botanical_identity_id) AS coalesce_1, $39::VARCHAR AS anon_12, CASE WHEN (harvest_material_inventory.state = $40::VARCHAR) THEN $41::INTEGER ELSE $42::INTEGER END AS anon_13, $43::INTEGER AS anon_14 
FROM harvest_material_inventory JOIN harvests ON harvests.id = harvest_material_inventory.harvest_id LEFT OUTER JOIN plants ON plants.id = harvests.plant_id LEFT OUTER JOIN plant_groups ON plant_groups.id = harvests.plant_group_id) AS anon_2 
WHERE anon_2.current = $44::INTEGER)
 SELECT (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM current_ids) AS anon_1, (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM wfo_links 
WHERE wfo_links.identity_id IN (SELECT current_ids.identity_id 
FROM current_ids)) AS anon_15, (SELECT count(*) AS count_3 
FROM botanical_profiles 
WHERE botanical_profiles.botanical_identity_id IN (SELECT current_ids.identity_id 
FROM current_ids) AND (botanical_profiles.description IS NOT NULL OR botanical_profiles.origin_distribution IS NOT NULL OR botanical_profiles.cultivation IS NOT NULL OR botanical_profiles.uses IS NOT NULL OR botanical_profiles.warnings IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT botanical_profile_native_ranges.botanical_profile_id 
FROM botanical_profile_native_ranges 
WHERE botanical_profile_native_ranges.botanical_profile_id = botanical_profiles.botanical_identity_id)))) AS anon_16

WITH RECURSIVE lineage_walk(kind, id, depth, path, is_cycle) AS (
        SELECT CAST($1 AS text), CAST($2 AS uuid), 0,
               ARRAY[CAST($1 AS text) || ':' || CAST($2 AS text)], false
        UNION ALL
        SELECT next.kind, next.id, walk.depth + 1,
               array_append(walk.path, next.kind || ':' || CAST(next.id AS text)),
               next.kind || ':' || CAST(next.id AS text) = ANY(walk.path)
        FROM lineage_walk AS walk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT 'plant'::text AS kind, lot.producer_plant_id AS id
            FROM seed_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'seed_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.producer_plant_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, lot.producer_plant_group_id
            FROM seed_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'seed_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.producer_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'sowing'::text, plant.originating_sowing_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_sowing_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, plant.originating_plant_group_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'sowing'::text, plant_group.originating_sowing_id
            FROM plant_groups AS plant_group
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant_group' AND plant_group.id = walk.id
              AND plant_group.originating_sowing_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'seed_lot'::text, sowing.seed_lot_id
            FROM sowings AS sowing
            WHERE walk.kind = 'sowing' AND sowing.id = walk.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant'::text, lot.mother_plant_id FROM vegetative_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'vegetative_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.mother_plant_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, lot.mother_plant_group_id FROM vegetative_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'vegetative_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.mother_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'vegetative_lot'::text, attempt.vegetative_lot_id
            FROM propagation_attempts AS attempt
            WHERE walk.kind = 'propagation_attempt' AND attempt.id = walk.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'propagation_attempt'::text, plant.originating_propagation_attempt_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_propagation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'propagation_attempt'::text, plant_group.originating_propagation_attempt_id
            FROM plant_groups AS plant_group
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant_group' AND plant_group.id = walk.id
              AND plant_group.originating_propagation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
        ) AS next
        WHERE NOT walk.is_cycle
    )
    SELECT kind, id, depth, is_cycle
    FROM lineage_walk
    ORDER BY depth

WITH RECURSIVE lineage_walk(kind, id, depth, path, is_cycle) AS (
        SELECT CAST($1 AS text), CAST($2 AS uuid), 0,
               ARRAY[CAST($1 AS text) || ':' || CAST($2 AS text)], false
        UNION ALL
        SELECT next.kind, next.id, walk.depth + 1,
               array_append(walk.path, next.kind || ':' || CAST(next.id AS text)),
               next.kind || ':' || CAST(next.id AS text) = ANY(walk.path)
        FROM lineage_walk AS walk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT 'plant'::text AS kind, lot.producer_plant_id AS id
            FROM seed_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'seed_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.producer_plant_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, lot.producer_plant_group_id
            FROM seed_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'seed_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.producer_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'sowing'::text, plant.originating_sowing_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_sowing_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, plant.originating_plant_group_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'sowing'::text, plant_group.originating_sowing_id
            FROM plant_groups AS plant_group
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant_group' AND plant_group.id = walk.id
              AND plant_group.originating_sowing_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'seed_lot'::text, sowing.seed_lot_id
            FROM sowings AS sowing
            WHERE walk.kind = 'sowing' AND sowing.id = walk.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant'::text, lot.mother_plant_id FROM vegetative_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'vegetative_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.mother_plant_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'plant_group'::text, lot.mother_plant_group_id FROM vegetative_lots AS lot
            WHERE walk.kind = 'vegetative_lot' AND lot.id = walk.id
              AND lot.mother_plant_group_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'vegetative_lot'::text, attempt.vegetative_lot_id
            FROM propagation_attempts AS attempt
            WHERE walk.kind = 'propagation_attempt' AND attempt.id = walk.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'propagation_attempt'::text, plant.originating_propagation_attempt_id
            FROM plants AS plant
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant' AND plant.id = walk.id
              AND plant.originating_propagation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'propagation_attempt'::text, plant_group.originating_propagation_attempt_id
            FROM plant_groups AS plant_group
            WHERE walk.kind = 'plant_group' AND plant_group.id = walk.id
              AND plant_group.originating_propagation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
        ) AS next
        WHERE NOT walk.is_cycle
    )
    SELECT kind, id, depth, is_cycle
    FROM lineage_walk
    ORDER BY depth

WITH RECURSIVE location_containment(ancestor_id, descendant_id) AS 
(SELECT locations.id AS ancestor_id, locations.id AS descendant_id 
FROM locations UNION SELECT location_containment.ancestor_id AS ancestor_id, locations.id AS id 
FROM location_containment JOIN locations ON locations.parent_id = location_containment.descendant_id), 
location_assignments AS 
(SELECT plants.location_id AS location_id, $1::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE plants.lifecycle = $2::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM plants 
WHERE plants.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY plants.location_id UNION ALL SELECT plant_groups.location_id AS location_id, $3::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE plant_groups.lifecycle = $4::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM plant_groups 
WHERE plant_groups.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY plant_groups.location_id UNION ALL SELECT sowings.location_id AS location_id, $5::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sowings.lifecycle = $6::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM sowings 
WHERE sowings.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sowings.location_id UNION ALL SELECT seed_lots.location_id AS location_id, $7::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE seed_lots.lifecycle = $8::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM seed_lots 
WHERE seed_lots.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY seed_lots.location_id UNION ALL SELECT vegetative_lots.location_id AS location_id, $9::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE vegetative_lots.lifecycle = $10::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM vegetative_lots 
WHERE vegetative_lots.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vegetative_lots.location_id UNION ALL SELECT propagation_attempts.location_id AS location_id, $11::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE propagation_attempts.lifecycle = $12::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM propagation_attempts 
WHERE propagation_attempts.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY propagation_attempts.location_id UNION ALL SELECT harvest_material_inventory.location_id AS location_id, $13::VARCHAR AS kind, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE harvest_material_inventory.state = $14::VARCHAR) AS active 
FROM harvest_material_inventory 
WHERE harvest_material_inventory.location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY harvest_material_inventory.location_id)
 SELECT location_containment.ancestor_id, location_assignments.kind, coalesce(sum(location_assignments.total) FILTER (WHERE location_containment.ancestor_id = location_containment.descendant_id), $15::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1, coalesce(sum(location_assignments.active) FILTER (WHERE location_containment.ancestor_id = location_containment.descendant_id), $16::INTEGER) AS coalesce_3, sum(location_assignments.total) AS sum_1, sum(location_assignments.active) AS sum_2 
FROM location_containment JOIN location_assignments ON location_assignments.location_id = location_containment.descendant_id GROUP BY location_containment.ancestor_id, location_assignments.kind
